reasoning: The icon depicts a classic interlocking plastic toy brick with two studs on top. It is an ideal match for tasks involving Lego sets, kids' toys, or playroom organization, and a common secondary symbol for software modules, plugins, or building blocks. Without plus/minus markings it is distinct from a car battery, though at very small sizes the two top studs can slightly resemble battery terminals or calendar rings.
